translationRepairs: To record them as barbarians would imply that the rulers of the Five Dynasties themselves could be treated as barbarians.
To record them as barbarians would mean that the rulers of the Five Dynasties could not treat them as barbarians.

Focus unit 五代之君未可以夷狄之也 makes the Five Dynasties rulers the agents who cannot treat the Ten Kingdoms as barbarians (夷狄之, object 之), matching s0020’s parallel 夷狄之則未可也. The prior idiomatic wrongly makes the rulers patients who could themselves be treated as barbarians; the proposed line restores agency and negation accurately.
To record them as barbarians would mean the rulers of the Five Dynasties could not be treated as barbarians.
To record them as barbarians would mean the rulers of the Five Dynasties could not treat them as barbarians.

The same clause has 五代之君 as subject of 未可以夷狄之, not as patients of being treated as barbarians. The prior literal inverts agent and patient; the proposed replacement correctly has the rulers unable to treat them as barbarians.
